purpose: Content anchors for input manifests and the few-shot example library that declare provenance from another set. Checked by scripts/check_manifest_provenance.py; see that script's docstring for the two check modes and why there are two.

anchor_basis_values.declaration-time: The blob hash the source actually had when the dependent artefact was built, established by reading the source at the commit named in declared_at_commit. The strong form.
anchor_basis_values.registry-creation: The source's blob hash when this registry was written (2026-09-13). The dependent artefact's build predates the registry, so this anchor cannot prove the past; it catches every FUTURE re-selection under the same name, which is the event the guard exists for.
anchor_basis_values.restamped: Re-recorded by --restamp after a deliberate, documented rebuild.
